question: Do Nvidia's earnings support the AI capex story?
reasons: For [fundamentals-1]: "Highlights Data Center Third-quarter revenue was a record $51.2 billion, up 25% from the previous quarter and up 66% from a year ago." https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-third-quarter-fiscal-2026

For [fundamentals-2]: "Professional Visualization Third-quarter revenue was $760 million, up 26% from the previous quarter and up 56% from a year ago." https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-third-quarter-fiscal-2026

For [fundamentals-3]: "Automotive and Robotics Third-quarter Automotive revenue was $592 million, up 1% from the previous quarter and up 32% from a year ago." https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-third-quarter-fiscal-2026
strongest_counterpoint: [news-7] "Nvidia shares end nearly 3% lower in choppy post-earnings trading session" https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=NVIDIA%20earnings%20data%20center%20guidance%20revenue%20when%3A30d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en
would_change_mind: Supports holds while claims for are at least double claims against (11 vs 5). 1 more checked claim against (for example a cut or decline in data center, guidance, revenue) would move it to Mixed.

bull.argument: Bull (the evidence supports the story) rests on 11 checked claims: [fundamentals-1] "Highlights Data Center Third-quarter revenue was a record $51.2 billion, up 25% from the previous quarter and up 66% from a year ago."; [fundamentals-2] "Professional Visualization Third-quarter revenue was $760 million, up 26% from the previous quarter and up 56% from a year ago."; [fundamentals-3] "Automotive and Robotics Third-quarter Automotive revenue was $592 million, up 1% from the previous quarter and up 32% from a year ago."
